Main-text and supplementary figures for `Sasaki_Pespeni_LCWG.qmd`. This document only plots: the models and summaries come from `Output/Reports/report.qmd` (saved to `Output/Output_data/ms_objects.rds` in its last section) and from the processed data and cluster export read by `Scripts/load_data.R`. Render the report first whenever an analysis changes (`00_controller.R` steps 7 and 8).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
library(ggpubr)
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("Scripts", "themes.R"))
source(here("Scripts", "palettes.R"))
source(here("Scripts", "load_data.R"))
ms_file <- here("Output", "Output_data", "ms_objects.rds")
if (!file.exists(ms_file)) stop("Render Output/Reports/report.qmd first: it writes ", ms_file)
list2env(readRDS(ms_file), envir = globalenv())
cat("Objects from report.qmd, saved", format(file.mtime(ms_file), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig-helpers
#| include: false
# rectangular phylogram as ggplot layers
tree_df <- function(tr) {
  tr <- ape::ladderize(tr)
  n <- ape::Ntip(tr)
  x <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(tr)
  y <- rep(NA_real_, n + tr$Nnode)
  tips <- tr$edge[tr$edge[, 2] <= n, 2]
  y[tips] <- rev(seq_along(tips))
  kids <- split(tr$edge[, 2], tr$edge[, 1])
  y_of <- function(nd) { if (!is.na(y[nd])) return(y[nd]); v <- mean(sapply(kids[[as.character(nd)]], y_of)); y[nd] <<- v; v }
  invisible(y_of(n + 1))
  edges <- tibble(p = tr$edge[, 1], c = tr$edge[, 2]) %>% mutate(x0 = x[p], x1 = x[c], y = y[c])
  verts <- map_dfr(names(kids), function(nd) { yy <- y[kids[[nd]]]; tibble(x = x[as.integer(nd)], y0 = min(yy), y1 = max(yy)) })
  nodes <- tibble(node = (n + 1):(n + tr$Nnode), x = x[node], y = y[node],
                  label = if (is.null(tr$node.label)) "" else as.character(tr$node.label))
  list(edges = edges, verts = verts, nodes = nodes,
       tips = tibble(label = tr$tip.label, x = x[1:n], y = y[1:n]), depth = max(x))
}
gg_tree <- function(tr, title, cols) {
  d <- tree_df(tr)
  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = d$edges, aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_segment(data = d$verts, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y0, yend = y1), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = filter(d$nodes, label != "", label != "NA"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
              hjust = 1.15, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
    geom_text(data = d$tips, aes(x = x + d$depth * 0.03, y = y, label = label, colour = label,
                                 fontface = if_else(grepl("^A\\.", label), "italic", "bold")),
              hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.45))) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig3
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
# Figure 3: phenotype - CTmax differs more per degree between sites (space) than through the season,
# within clades (plasticity) and through clade composition (turnover)
ci_tab <- function(m, terms) {
  b <- lme4::fixef(m); se <- sqrt(diag(as.matrix(vcov(m))))
  tibble(term = terms, est = b[terms], lo = b[terms] - 1.96 * se[terms], hi = b[terms] + 1.96 * se[terms])
}

diff_dat <- wb_diff %>% filter(split == "Season-mean split") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = rev(c("All clades", tonsa_clades))), all = group == "All clades")

m3_slopes <- ggplot(diff_dat, aes(x = diff, y = group, colour = group, shape = all)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 1.5, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(clade_cols[tonsa_clades], `All clades` = "black"), guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 18), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Spatial − seasonal slope\n(°C CTmax per °C)", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11)


# variance-partition colours: away from the clade / latitude red-blue scheme.
# Nuisance terms in greys, grouping terms in muted earth tones, and the two temperature terms
# as a dark/light pair of one hue (dark = spatial, light = seasonal, as in panel B).
vp_order <- c("Individual", "Assay", "Collection (other)", "Clade", "Site (other)",
              "Spatial temperature", "Seasonal temperature")

vp_cols <- c(Individual = "#EDEDED", Assay = "#C8C8C8", `Collection (other)` = "#A9BFA0",
             Clade = "#555555", `Site (other)` = "#C3B8D6",
             `Spatial temperature` = "#7A4E1F", `Seasonal temperature` = "#D2A86E")

vp_plot <- filter(vp_tab, share > 0) %>% mutate(component = factor(component, levels = vp_order))

m4_ctmax <- ggplot(vp_plot, aes(x = model, y = share, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "white", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, 18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = vp_cols, name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of CTmax variance") +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

m3_turn <- ggplot(turn_tab, aes(x = est, y = component, colour = axis, shape = axis)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.5, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Seasonal = "grey55", Spatial = "black"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Seasonal = 17, Spatial = 16), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, 14)) +
  labs(x = "Slope\n(°C CTmax per °C)", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggarrange(ggarrange(m3_slopes, m3_turn, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1.3), labels = c("A", "B")),
          m4_ctmax, ncol = 1, heights = c(0.9, 1), labels = c("", "C"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig4
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.8
# Figure 4: genome - variation lies between sites, not seasons; seasonal change does not echo spatial temperature associations
# F spans divergent populations (Florida vs Chesapeake), so its between-site variance is ~10x the
# other clades': one panel per clade, each on its own scale
m4_freq_n <- ggplot(filter(vp_freq, !is.na(value)) %>% 
                      mutate(group = factor(group, levels = tonsa_clades)),
                    aes(x = component, y = value, shape = component, colour = group, group = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 1.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clade_cols) + 
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Scaled allele-frequency variance") +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# concordance: seasonal z of each SNP, signed by its spatial direction (> 0 = same direction through
# the season as across sites); top 1% spatial SNPs vs all others. Fraction > 0 among the top 1% = the
# sign agreement of the concordance test; chance range from the within-site temperature permutations.
# |z| beyond 4.5, including the +-10 cap of the GLM (fits where an allele is missing from some
# populations), are kept and shown in the end bins.
conc_null <- conc %>% filter(snp_set == "all chr.", null == "seasonal", snps_used == "unlinked") %>%
  mutate(clade = as.character(clade)) %>% filter(clade %in% c("X", "F")) %>%
  group_by(clade) %>% summarise(obs = conc_top1[observed][1], lo = min(conc_top1[!observed]),
                                hi = max(conc_top1[!observed]), .groups = "drop")

conc_snps <- map_dfr(c("X", "F"), ~ read_tsv(cx("results", "14_concordance", paste0(.x, ".unlinked.snps.tsv.gz")),
                                            col_types = cols(chrom = "c", .default = col_double())) %>%
                       mutate(clade = .x)) %>%
  group_by(clade) %>%
  mutate(top = abs(z_spatial) >= quantile(abs(z_spatial), 0.99),
         oz = z_seasonal * sign(z_spatial)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(clade, levels = c("X", "F")))

# agreement as computed by the concordance test (cluster)
conc_lab <- conc_snps %>% filter(top) %>% group_by(clade) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(mutate(conc_null, clade = factor(clade, levels = c("X", "F"))), by = "clade") %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("Top 1%% (%d SNPs)\n%.0f%% same direction\nchance: %.0f to %.0f%%", n, 100 * obs, 100 * lo, 100 * hi))

conc_snps <- mutate(conc_snps, oz = pmin(pmax(oz, -4.6), 4.6))   # overflow into the end bins

conc_snps <- conc_snps %>%
  mutate(set = if_else(top, paste0("Top 1% spatial SNPs (", clade, ")"), "All other SNPs"))

set_cols <- c(`Top 1% spatial SNPs (X)` = scales::alpha(clade_cols[["X"]], 0.75),
              `Top 1% spatial SNPs (F)` = scales::alpha(clade_cols[["F"]], 0.75),
              `All other SNPs` = "grey80")

m4_conc <- ggplot(conc_snps, aes(x = oz, fill = set)) +
  geom_histogram(data = ~ filter(.x, !top), aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 0,
                 colour = NA) +
  geom_histogram(data = ~ filter(.x, top), aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 0,
                 colour = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ clade, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4.625, -2, 0, 2, 4.625), labels = c("≤ −4.5", "−2", "0", "2", "≥ 4.5")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = set_cols, breaks = names(set_cols), name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Seasonal temperature z-score", y = "Density") +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggarrange(m4_freq_n, m4_conc, 
          nrow = 1, widths = c(0.85, 1.15), 
          labels = c("A", "B"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig5
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5
# Figure 5: clade differences in CTmax and acclimation, from ctmax ~ clade * temperature (+ site, replicate, tube)
t_off <- mean(filtered_data$collection_temp - filtered_data$temp_cent)

ci_cols <- function(d) c(intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(d))[1], intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(d))[1])

clade_rng <- filtered_data %>% filter(clade %in% tonsa_clades) %>%
  group_by(clade) %>% summarise(lo = min(temp_cent), hi = max(temp_cent), .groups = "drop")

pred5 <- pmap_dfr(clade_rng, function(clade, lo, hi) {
  as_tibble(summary(emmeans::emmeans(ctmax.model, ~ clade | temp_cent,
                                     at = list(clade = clade, temp_cent = seq(lo, hi, length.out = 30)))))
}) %>% mutate(clade = factor(as.character(clade), levels = tonsa_clades), temp = temp_cent + t_off)

cc <- ci_cols(pred5)

pt5 <- filtered_data %>% filter(clade %in% tonsa_clades) %>% mutate(clade = factor(clade, levels = tonsa_clades))

m5a <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pt5, aes(x = collection_temp, y = ctmax, colour = clade), alpha = 0.3, size = 1.3,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred5, aes(x = temp, ymin = .data[[cc[1]]], ymax = .data[[cc[2]]], fill = clade), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = pred5, aes(x = temp, y = emmean, colour = clade), linewidth = 1.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade") +
  labs(x = "Collection temperature (°C)", y = "CTmax (°C)") +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

mm <- as_tibble(summary(emmeans::emmeans(ctmax.model, ~ clade), infer = TRUE))

tr <- as_tibble(summary(emmeans::emtrends(ctmax.model, ~ clade, var = "temp_cent"), infer = TRUE))

m5b <- bind_rows(
  transmute(mm, clade, est = emmean, lo = .data[[ci_cols(mm)[1]]], hi = .data[[ci_cols(mm)[2]]],
            panel = sprintf("CTmax at %.0f °C (°C)", t_off)),
  transmute(tr, clade, est = temp_cent.trend, lo = .data[[ci_cols(tr)[1]]], hi = .data[[ci_cols(tr)[2]]],
            panel = "Acclimation slope (°C per °C)")) %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(as.character(clade), levels = tonsa_clades), panel = factor(panel, levels = unique(panel))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = clade, y = est, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, colour = clade)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Clade", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank())

ggarrange(m5a, m5b, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.2, 1), labels = c("A", "B"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5
# Figure 6: warming tolerance with lineages + acclimation (distribution), and the warmest day under each scenario
if (have_mur) {
  
  hist6 <- wt_days %>%
    filter(scenario == "Clades + acclimation") %>%
    mutate(bin = floor(wt)) %>%
    group_by(region, warming, bin) %>% summarise(w = sum(w), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(region) %>% mutate(h = 0.9 * w / max(w)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(y0 = as.integer(region) - 1)
  
  m6_hist <- ggplot(hist6) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = y0), data = distinct(hist6, region, y0), colour = "grey80") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = bin, xmax = bin + 1, ymin = y0, ymax = y0 + h, fill = region, alpha = warming)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_cols[region_order], guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`+4 °C` = 0.35, Current = 0.9), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(region_order) - 1 + 0.35, labels = region_order, expand = expansion(add = c(0.1, 0.2))) +
    labs(x = "Daily warming tolerance, July–November (°C)", y = NULL) +
    theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  
  m6_hot <- wt_res %>%
    filter(scenario %in% scen_levels, metric != "Aug–Sep mean") %>%
    mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scen_levels),
           warming = factor(if_else(warming == 0, "Current", "+4 °C"), levels = c("Current", "+4 °C"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = region, y = est, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, colour = scenario, shape = scenario)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ warming, ncol = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Fixed CTmax` = "grey65", `Clade means` = "grey35", `Clades + acclimation` = "black"),
                        name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`Fixed CTmax` = 15, `Clade means` = 17, `Clades + acclimation` = 16), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Warming tolerance on the warmest day (°C)") +
    theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
  
  ggarrange(m6_hist, m6_hot, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1), labels = c("A", "B"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-drift
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4
# Supplementary: seasonal allele-frequency change and temporal Ne
# (A) Ne per seasonal pair (log scale; 95% CI from the chromosome jackknife; arrow = upper bound
#     unbounded, open point = excess not above zero), grouped by clade / F lineage, against the
#     long-term Ne from nucleotide diversity (grey band, mutation rate 1e-8 to 1e-9).
# (B) calibrated excess Fc against generations, with the drift expectation t / (2 Ne) for reference Ne.

lin_of_site <- c(MR = "F-MR", FH = "F-FH", MD = "F-N", GW = "F-N")

grp_levels <- c("X", "F-N", "F-FH", "F-MR", "S")

ne_cap <- 3e6                                           # right edge of panel A

ne_long <- read_csv(here("Output", "Output_data", "ne_comparison.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(group, ne_long_1e8, ne_long_1e9) %>% 
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = grp_levels))

ne_dat <- temporal %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(as.character(clade), levels = tonsa_clades),
         group = factor(if_else(clade == "F", unname(lin_of_site[site]), as.character(clade)), levels = grp_levels),
         label = paste0(site, " ", from, "–", to, if_else(clade == "F", paste0(" (", group, ")"), "")),
         open_hi = !is.finite(ne_hi),
         ne_pt = pmin(ne, ne_cap), ne_hi_pt = pmin(ne_hi, ne_cap)) %>%
  left_join(ne_long, by = "group") %>%
  arrange(group, site, gens) %>%
  mutate(label = fct_rev(fct_inorder(label)))


mS_ne <- ggplot(ne_dat, aes(y = label, colour = clade)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ne_long_1e8, xend = ne_long_1e9, yend = label), colour = "grey88",
               linewidth = 7, lineend = "butt") +       # long-term Ne of the pair's clade / lineage
  geom_segment(aes(x = ne_lo, xend = ne_hi_pt, yend = label), linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = ~ filter(.x, open_hi), aes(x = ne_cap / 1.5, xend = ne_cap, yend = label),
               linewidth = 0.8, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(x = ne_pt, shape = is.finite(ne)), size = 2.4, fill = "white") +
  facet_grid(clade ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 21), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(100, ne_cap), breaks = 10^(2:6), labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade", drop = TRUE) +
  labs(x = expression(N[e] ~ "(log scale)"), y = NULL) +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.placement = "outside", strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0))


gmax <- max(temporal$gens) + 1

ne_ref <- tibble(Ne = c(100, 500, 2000, 10000)) %>% crossing(gens = c(0, gmax)) %>% mutate(excess = gens / (2 * Ne))

ne_ref_lab <- tibble(Ne = c(100, 500, 2000, 10000)) %>%
  mutate(gens = pmin(gmax, 0.0185 * 2 * Ne), excess = gens / (2 * Ne))   # label where each line leaves the panel

mS_fc <- ggplot(ne_dat, aes(x = gens, colour = clade)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(data = ne_ref, aes(x = gens, y = excess, group = Ne), colour = "grey70", linetype = "dashed",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = ne_ref_lab, aes(x = gens, y = excess, label = paste("Ne =", scales::comma(Ne))),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(y = excess, ymin = excess - 1.96 * se, ymax = excess + 1.96 * se), size = 0.45) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade", drop = TRUE) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, gmax), ylim = c(-0.006, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Generations between samples", y = expression("Excess " * F[c] ~ "(calibrated)")) +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# (C) split-half calibration: c = effective chromosomes per individual / 2, one point per population
#     (mean of two random splits); dashed line = two full chromosomes per individual (genotypes known)
mS_c <- ggplot(c_pop, aes(x = clade, y = c, colour = clade)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade", drop = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(x = "Clade", y = "Effective chromosomes per individual / 2 (c)") +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggarrange(mS_ne, mS_fc, mS_c, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.15, 1, 1), labels = c("A", "B", "C"),
          common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-concordance
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3.5
# Supplementary: sign agreement of seasonal and spatial temperature associations among the top 1% spatial
# SNPs - one dot per distinct within-site ordering of the sampling events (exact null); black line = observed;
# dashed line = 50% (no concordance). X and F only (S has one alternative ordering, IV no repeated sampling)
conc_perm <- conc %>%
  filter(snp_set == "all chr.", null == "seasonal", snps_used == "unlinked",
         as.character(clade) %in% c("X", "F")) %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(as.character(clade), levels = c("X", "F")), agree = 100 * conc_top1)

conc_rank <- conc_perm %>% group_by(clade) %>%
  summarise(obs = agree[observed], n = n(),
            rank = sum(abs(agree - 50) >= abs(obs - 50)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("observed %.0f%%\n%d of %d orderings as extreme", obs, rank, n))

ggplot(filter(conc_perm, !observed), aes(x = agree, fill = clade)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_dotplot(binwidth = 2, method = "histodot", stackratio = 1.1, colour = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(conc_perm, observed), aes(xintercept = agree), colour = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = conc_rank, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.95) +
  facet_wrap(~ clade, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clade_cols[c("X", "F")], guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Top 1% spatial SNPs with seasonal change in the spatial direction (%)") +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11)
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-temp-components

# Supplementary: data behind Fig. 3A - CTmax against the two components of collection temperature,
# by clade. Points: collections (mean +- SE of CTmax with the other component's effect removed);
# lines: clade-specific slopes from the season-mean model
sm_plot <- function(pn, xlab) {
  ggplot(filter(sm_pts, panel == pn), aes(x = x, y = y, colour = lineage)) +
    geom_segment(data = filter(sm_lines, panel == pn), aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y0, yend = y1),
                 linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = y - se, ymax = y + se), size = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = filter(sm_lines, panel == pn), aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("%.2f °C per °C", b)),
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3, colour = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ lineage, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], guide = "none") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "CTmax (°C)") +
    theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11)
}
ggarrange(sm_plot("Seasonal", "Season's mean collection temperature across sites (°C)"),
          sm_plot("Spatial", "Collection temperature minus the season's mean (°C)"),
          ncol = 1, labels = c("A", "B"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-ctmax-variance
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5
# Supplementary: spread of CTmax within clades through the season. (A) SD of CTmax per collection for each
# clade x site sampled in >= 2 seasons (collections with >= 5 individuals of the clade); (B) change in mean
# absolute deviation from the collection median relative to early season (Brown-Forsythe; |dev| ~ season +
# (1 | clade:site)), 95% CI
vs_sd <- read_csv(here("Output", "Output_data", "ctmax_sd_by_collection.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(season = factor(season, levels = season_order), lineage = factor(lineage, levels = tonsa_clades))
vs_tab <- read_csv(here("Output", "Output_data", "ctmax_variance_season.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("peak vs early", "late vs early"),
                           labels = c("Peak vs early", "Late vs early")))

mS_vsd <- ggplot(vs_sd, aes(x = season, y = sd, group = unit, colour = lineage)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade", drop = TRUE) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 3.5), name = "Individuals") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.3, 0.6))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "SD of CTmax within the collection (°C)") +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

mS_vtab <- ggplot(vs_tab, aes(x = estimate, y = contrast)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 1.5, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = "Change in mean |deviation| from\nthe collection median (°C)", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11)

ggarrange(mS_vsd, mS_vtab, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.4, 1), 
          labels = c("A", "B"))

```


```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-infection
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10
# Supplementary: parasites and epibionts. (A) share of individuals carrying each group, by site and season
# (SSU screen of unmapped reads; >= 5 pairs and >= 2 per million); (B) CTmax and body size of carriers vs
# non-carriers within the same collections (collections with >= 2 of each)
micro_labels <- c(paradinium = "Paradinium (parasite)", trematode = "Hemiuroid trematodes",
                  apostome = "Apostome ciliates", peritrich = "Peritrich ciliates (Zoothamnium)",
                  cnidaria_myxozoa = "Cnidaria / Myxozoa")
micro_prev <- seq_data %>%
  filter(clade %in% tonsa_clades, !library_failed) %>%
  select(sample_id, site_code, season, ends_with("_call")) %>%
  pivot_longer(ends_with("_call"), names_to = "group", values_to = "call", names_pattern = "(.*)_call") %>%
  filter(group %in% names(micro_labels)) %>%
  group_by(group, site_code, season) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), k = sum(call), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(group = names(micro_labels), site_code = site_order, season = season_order) %>%
  mutate(prev = k / n,
         group = factor(micro_labels[group], levels = rev(micro_labels)),
         site_code = factor(site_code, levels = site_order),
         season = factor(season, levels = season_order))

mS_prev <- ggplot(micro_prev, aes(x = site_code, y = group)) +
  facet_grid(~ season) +
  geom_text(data = ~ filter(.x, is.na(n)), label = "–", size = 3.5, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, !is.na(n), k == 0), shape = 1, size = 1.3, colour = "grey75") +
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, k > 0), aes(size = prev), colour = "grey15") +
  geom_text(data = ~ filter(.x, k > 0), aes(label = paste0(k, "/", n)),
            nudge_y = -0.38, size = 2.6, colour = "grey45") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 9, breaks = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.6, 1), labels = scales::percent,
                  name = "Individuals\npositive") +
  labs(x = "Site (south → north)", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92"), 
        legend.position = "right")

inf_groups <- c(paradinium = "Paradinium", trematode = "Trematodes",
                apostome = "Apostome ciliates", peritrich = "Peritrich ciliates")
inf <- join_data %>%
  select(sample_id, site_code, season, clade, ctmax, size, paste0(names(inf_groups), "_call")) %>%
  pivot_longer(ends_with("_call"), names_to = "group", values_to = "positive",
               names_pattern = "(.*)_call") %>%
  mutate(collection = paste(site_code, season)) %>%
  group_by(group, collection) %>%
  filter(sum(positive) >= 2, sum(!positive) >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(group = factor(inf_groups[group], levels = inf_groups),
         status = factor(if_else(positive, "Carrier", "Non-carrier"), levels = c("Non-carrier", "Carrier")))

mS_inf <- inf %>%
  pivot_longer(c(ctmax, size), names_to = "trait") %>%
  mutate(trait = recode(trait, ctmax = "CTmax (°C)", size = "Prosome length (mm)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = collection, y = value, colour = status)) +
  facet_grid(trait ~ group, scales = "free", space = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(group = label_wrap_gen(12))) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.6),
             size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 8,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Non-carrier` = "grey65", Carrier = "grey10"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Collection (site, season)", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

ggarrange(mS_prev, mS_inf, ncol = 1, heights = c(0.8, 1), labels = c("A", "B"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-diversity
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 9
# Supplementary: diversity and relatedness within populations. (A) theta_pi per site and (B) Tajima's D
# per population (95% CI, block bootstrap over 1 Mb blocks; folded spectra); (C) KING-robust kinship of
# every pair of individuals within each population (ngsRelate); dashed lines: second- (0.125) and
# first-degree (0.25) relatives
div_pop <- read_csv(here("Output", "Output_data", "diversity_populations.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(clade, levels = tonsa_clades), site = factor(site, levels = site_order),
         season = factor(season, levels = season_order))

div_long <- div_pop %>%
  transmute(clade, site, season,
            `θπ per site_est` = pi, `θπ per site_lo` = pi_lo95, `θπ per site_hi` = pi_hi95,
            `Tajima's D_est` = tajima_D, `Tajima's D_lo` = tajima_D_lo95, `Tajima's D_hi` = tajima_D_hi95) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(clade, site, season), names_to = c("stat", ".value"), names_sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
  mutate(stat = factor(stat, levels = c("θπ per site", "Tajima's D")))

mS_div <- function(s) {
  ggplot(filter(div_long, stat == s), aes(x = site, y = est, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, shape = season, colour = clade)) +
    { if (s == "Tajima's D") geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") } +
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 1.5) +
    facet_grid(~ clade, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(early = 16, peak = 17, late = 15), name = "Season", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = s) +
    theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11)
}

rel <- read_csv(here("Output", "Output_data", "relatedness_pairs.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(clade, levels = tonsa_clades), site = factor(site, levels = site_order),
         season = factor(season, levels = season_order))

mS_king <- ggplot(rel, aes(x = season, y = KING, colour = clade, shape = season)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.125, 0.25), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(~ clade + site, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(early = 16, peak = 17, late = 15), name = "Season", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "KING-robust kinship") +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), strip.text = element_text(size = 8))

ggarrange(mS_div("θπ per site"), mS_div("Tajima's D"), mS_king, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1, 1.1),
          labels = c("A", "B", "C"), common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-size

# Supplementary: body size (prosome length) by clade, phenotype analysis set; dashed line = median
size_dat <- join_data %>% filter(clade %in% tonsa_clades, !is.na(size)) %>%

size_med <- size_dat %>% group_by(clade) %>% summarise(med = median(size), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-temp-split
#| fig-width: 12.5
#| fig-height: 5.8
# Supplementary: the two ways of splitting collection temperature into seasonal and spatial parts,
# drawn from the 22 collection temperatures. Each collection's temperature = reference mean +
# seasonal part + spatial part. (A) season-mean split (main analysis); (B) site-mean split (sensitivity).

ts_coll <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(clade %in% tonsa_clades) %>%
  distinct(site_code, season, collection_temp) %>%
  mutate(site_code = factor(site_code, levels = site_order), season = factor(season, levels = season_order))

# (A) season-mean split
ts_season <- ts_coll %>% group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(ref = mean(collection_temp), n_sites = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(x = as.integer(season))

ts_g1 <- mean(ts_season$ref)

ts_a <- ts_coll %>% left_join(ts_season %>% select(season, ref), by = "season") %>%
  mutate(x = as.integer(season) + (as.integer(site_code) - 4.5) * 0.07)

mS_split_a <- ggplot(ts_a) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ts_g1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_text(data = ts_season, aes(x = x + 0.35, y = ref, label = sprintf("%+.1f", ref - ts_g1)), hjust = 0, size = 2.9, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x, xend = x, y = ref, yend = collection_temp, colour = site_code), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = ts_season, aes(x = x - 0.3, xend = x + 0.3, y = ref, yend = ref), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = collection_temp, colour = site_code), size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(data = ts_season, aes(x = x, y = 7.5, label = sprintf("%d sites", n_sites)), size = 2.8, colour = "grey35") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pop_cols, name = "Site", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("Early", "Peak", "Late"), limits = c(0.6, 3.75)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(7, 37), breaks = seq(10, 35, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Collection temperature (°C)",
       title = "Season-mean split (main analysis)") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme_matt(11) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

# (B) site-mean split
ts_site <- ts_coll %>% group_by(site_code) %>%
  summarise(ref = mean(collection_temp), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(x = as.integer(site_code))

ts_g2 <- mean(ts_site$ref)

ts_b <- ts_coll %>% left_join(ts_site %>% select(site_code, ref), by = "site_code") %>%
  mutate(x = as.integer(site_code) + (as.integer(season) - 2) * 0.18)

mS_split_b <- ggplot(ts_b) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ts_g2, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_text(data = ts_site, aes(x = x + 0.36, y = if_else(ref >= ts_g2, ref + 1, ref - 1),
                                label = sprintf("%+.1f", ref - ts_g2)), size = 2.7, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x, xend = x, y = ref, yend = collection_temp, colour = site_code), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = ts_site, aes(x = x - 0.3, xend = x + 0.3, y = ref, yend = ref), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = collection_temp, colour = site_code, shape = season), size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(data = filter(ts_site, n < 3), aes(x = x, y = 7.5, label = "no early"), size = 2.8, colour = "grey35") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pop_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(early = 16, peak = 17, late = 15), labels = c("Early", "Peak", "Late"), name = "Season") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:8, labels = site_order, limits = c(0.6, 8.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(7, 37), breaks = seq(10, 35, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Site (south → north)", y = "Collection temperature (°C)",
       title = "Site-mean split (sensitivity analysis)") +
  theme_matt(11) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

ggarrange(mS_split_a, mS_split_b, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1.35), labels = c("A", "B"), align = "h")
```
